$comment: What the cross-process write lock (ADR-0005, item 7) writes for the computer: the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the lowercased computer name (UTF-8), not the name itself. Checked by packages/cli/test/fs-store.test.ts (machineId), tests/AppTests/FileLockTests.cs (FileLock.MachineId) and the Mac shell's FileLock tests.
